description: Consumer unit replacement, 3-bed semi in Derby, 10 circuits, RCBOs, SPD

line_items.description: [Switches & Sockets] British General Circuit Protection 12-Module 10-Way Part-Populated High Integrity Main Switch Consumer Unit with SPD
RCBOs, Type A 30mA, ratings to suit existing circuits
Labour: remove existing unit and install new CU, SPD, and 10 RCBO circuits
Labour: testing, commissioning, and BS 7671 certification

ai_assumptions: Existing earthing and bonding meet current BS 7671 requirements and do not require upgrading.
All 10 circuits are identifiable, accessible, and in sound condition with no hidden defects.
New consumer unit can be surface-mounted in the existing location without relocation or additional containment.
Work can be completed in a single visit with standard access to the distribution area.
Incoming supply tails and meter are adequate and accessible for isolation.
ai_notes: Guide quote only. Electrician must verify RCBO types/ratings, confirm the exact consumer unit model suits the installation, and check whether earthing/bonding upgrades are required before issuing final certificate. No site photos were provided.
